verdict.rationale: Retell AI is a SaaS voice-agent platform with a CLI and SDKs, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no such control. The per-agent data retention setting is a different feature: it automatically deletes call and chat data, and does not let users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
